 Most recent Most popular Newcastle struggling at both ends of pitch published at 14:39 GMT 14:39 GMT 
 Fulham v Newcastle (15:00 GMT) 
 Sophie Brown 
BBC Sport 
 After losing a division-high seventh home league match of 2026, it will perhaps be something of a relief for Newcastle to get back on the road.
 Booed off after a dismal showing in defeat by Everton on Monday, which was capped by a red card for midfielder Jacob Ramsey, the Magpies need to address the problems that face them at both ends of the pitch.
 Only Crystal Palace have faced more shots in the Premier League this season than Newcastle, whose average of 17.1 shots faced per game is currently their most in a season on record since 2003-04.
 Meanwhile, only Aston Villa have had fewer shots on target than Newcastle's 29 shots. Only two of the Magpies' 17 shots against Everton were on target, with their percentage of shots on target sitting at 25.7% (29/113), the third lowest in the Premier League.
 All of this points to a resigned-looking side that is lacking in confidence, which might help to explain why Newcastle have lost 16 of their past 18 league games when conceding first.

 'Arsenal will grind out a result here' published at 14:36 GMT 14:36 GMT 
 Arsenal v Hull (15:00 GMT) 
 Hull City are scrapping for points and hanging on in there in a lot of games.
 I get a lot of my predictions wrong for their games because I always go for them to lose, but I am not going to do anything different for them this week because of who they are playing.
 Arsenal are just monsters, aren't they? They always seem to find a way and do enough to win games, even when they don't play well, and they will grind another result out here if they have to.
 Sutton's prediction: 2-0

 'Big result for Leeds' published at 14:30 GMT 14:30 GMT 
 FT: Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Tottenham and Leeds midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Leeds deserve the three points. In the second half they came out and they didn't disappoint. 
 They were more aggressive, got in behind and had more willing runners. 
 It felt like it was coming for Leeds too. The pressure just kept coming and the substitutions then came.
 Big, big result for Leeds United.
